posted_date_range.scope: core canonical postings only (the analysis set); per-source first_posted/last_posted in `sources` cover all rows of the source

analysis_set: canonical rows with role_family in CORE_FAMILIES

regional_count_basis.styria_core: any listed site: core postings with at least one location in Styria (is_styria flag; multi-site ads count in every state they list). Used by T02 styria_count, T03c, T04a styria, T07e and every *_by_styria table.
regional_count_basis.vienna_core: any listed site: core postings with at least one location in Vienna (is_vienna flag).
regional_count_basis.graz_area_core: any listed site: core postings with at least one location in the Graz commuting area (is_graz_area flag); a subset of styria_core.
regional_count_basis.styria_core_primary_state: primary state: core postings whose primary `state` is Steiermark (one state per ad; T03a_state_counts.csv, DS05).
regional_count_basis.vienna_core_primary_state: primary state: core postings whose primary `state` is Wien (T03a_state_counts.csv, DS05).
regional_count_basis.graz_area_core_primary_styria: Graz commuting area postings whose primary state is Steiermark (subset of styria_core_primary_state).

note: Derived from outputs/tables; regenerate with src/analysis/export_agent_json.py after re-running the pipeline.
